issues: Lesson 7/8 use different AM/PM for the same D24 example; this also appears in Appendix B.
Lesson 12 latitude 80N58 exceeds this app’s supported range and conflicts with the described location; no silent correction.
Lesson 20 gives conflicting dasha-selection priorities and a questionable Dwadashottari cycle length; only candidate conditions are implemented.
Lesson 23 uses an ambiguous OR in the Mahapurusha condition.
Lesson 33 gives a ten-year Sagittarius period but later describes some thirds as four years; arithmetic is checked independently.
Lesson 38 lists the same Jupiter transit house as both favorable and unfavorable; no unqualified rule was imported.
Lesson 42 uses Kashinatha Hora; the app’s existing D2 is Sun/Moon Hora. Those financial examples cannot be graded as the same chart.
